theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners rank #2 with strong momentum score (1.557), the highest durability_bar among top-5 eligible themes (0.62), breadth 0.75 (cohesive, not a single-name squeeze), and uncrowded (z=0.45). It reads as the most robust non-dominant leadership — a broad precious-metals miner tape with trend discipline intact, while the crowded Memory/HBM leader shows breadth 0.0 (a single-name spike).
theses.dissent: Precious-metal miners are high-beta to silver spot; if the geopolitical/macro premium that supported silver deflates (unscheduled_share 0.85 suggests headline-driven tape), SIL can reverse sharply regardless of internal breadth.

falsifier.text: Silver Miners lose their relative rank position and SIL underperforms GDX by 8% or more relative over a rolling 20-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners rank #3 with the strongest breadth signal in the entire eligible set (0.917) and highest durability_bar (0.73), uncrowded (z=0.24). This is the broadest, most durable trend in the list — leadership is spread across many names rather than concentrated, which is the texture that survives shake-outs best under the absolute-trend gate.
theses.dissent: Gold miners have already participated heavily; high breadth can mark late-stage participation where marginal buyers are exhausted, and a rising real-yield regime would pressure the entire complex.

falsifier.text: GDX breadth (fraction of constituents above 50-day MA) drops below 0.5 while GDX itself falls more than 6% from current level before the check-by date

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Memory/HBM is the dominant leader (rank 1, score 3.0, r10 0.0504) and the trend-gate is eligible. But breadth is 0.0 — the entire leadership rests on a single-name spike — and it is crowded (z=1.39). Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution, not a fade. Leaning modestly in direction of the confirmed leader while flagging that this is the most fragile leadership texture: one name, crowded, mixed Hurst.
theses.dissent: Breadth 0.0 means the entire theme leadership is one stock; if that single name mean-reverts (Hurst mixed), the whole theme score collapses and there is no internal support underneath.

falsifier.text: The single-name driver behind Memory/HBM leadership loses its 20-day momentum and the theme's breadth remains 0.0 while SMH lags the challenger SIL by more than 10% relative before the check-by date
